sermon.title: World Governments’ Final Source of Power— November 7, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Jesus told Pilate his authority came from above. God removes and raises up kings, Satan lied about the kingdoms, and Christians are responsible to choose able, God-fearing leaders and speak to rulers so God can heal the land.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Message begins at 44:54 after worship and a Johnny Cash special. Spoken “Timothy 1 2” given as Titus 1:2.

chunks.section_question: What did Jesus tell Pilate?

To be sentenced to die on the cross you would have no authority over me if it were not given to you from above. God. Is the final. Deciding factor. In governments and their leaders. faqs.question: What is the final source of power for world governments?
faqs.answer: God Himself; Pilate’s authority was given from above.

faqs.question: Who removes and raises up kings?
Should young Christians pursue government?
faqs.answer: Yes—go to college, become a lawyer, learn political science.

faqs.question: Are some rulers set up without God?
faqs.answer: Yes: “They set up kings, but not by Me.”

faqs.question: Does Satan rule the kingdoms of men?
faqs.answer: No—he lied to Jesus; the Most High rules.

faqs.question: What three things did God give government?
faqs.answer: Taxes, military and a judicial system.

faqs.question: What practical step does he urge?
faqs.answer: Bombard officials with scripture posts and short videos.

faqs.question: Why do we get bad leaders?
faqs.answer: God gives leaders that match our quality of character when we don’t repent.

faqs.question: Is it God’s fault what’s happening in America?
faqs.answer: No—nor the remnant’s; they endure the season of correction.

faqs.question: How can the land be healed?
